_rationale: Stddev=0 makes the lognormal formula deterministic: exp(mu + 0*z) = exp(log(1.05)) = 1.05. Every year except 2028 is +5% blended. 2028 black swan multiplies factors → stock 0.525, bond 0.945, blended 0.6*0.525 + 0.4*0.945 = 0.693. path[0]=500000 (start of 2026), path[1]=500000*1.05=525000, path[2]=525000*1.05=551250, path[3]=551250*0.693=382016.25, path[4]=382016.25*1.05=401117.06. probability=100 (no spending).
